label: r02-A-T3-8
critiques: The trial prompt says "Do not read ${ANSWERS}, ${GRADER}, or ${JUDGE_RUBRIC}", and the agent receives none of those files. The prompt never mentions spe/predictions/r04.yaml or the predictions folder, so one required item is missing.

Gate 5 runs a dry run of "1 ticket and 1 trial per config" before launch. It measures estTrialUsd and estJudgeUsd, and the script will not start without those values. This is a dry run on a few cells that comes before the full run.
Gate 3 is a grader selftest that uses a fixture that must score 100% and a fixture that must score 0%. No gate regrades round 3 results as a control.

The script throws if PROJECTED_USD > CAP_USD. Before each wave it also checks whether `spentUsd + nextWaveUsd > CAP_USD`, and if so it logs a stopReason and stops. The cap is checked before costly trials, and each skip is logged.

The code grader runs grade.py against answers.json and reports category_acc, priority_acc and both_acc. The Opus judge scores only reply tone against judge.md. The roles are split as the check requires.
The script runs a fixed 5 trials per cell. It has no logic that adds trials to cells where only some trials passed, and it states no cap for extra trials.

The Summary phase only computes tone means and a `complete` flag. No agent runs a failure analysis or a completeness critique. The round is also hardcoded in several places ('r04', RUN_DIR, the prompt text). No single constant or argument holds it.
